sex.quote: Before analysis, males (10.1% of total captures) were excluded from the data set because of sex-related differences in body lengths, and because females are the primary foraging and nest-building sex.

caste.quote: Intraspecific body size measurements of worker bees can vary geographically (Skandalis et al. 2009), seasonally (Quezada-Euán et al. 2011), and individually over the course of their adult life (León-Contrera et al. 2006).
